text:
kai (PM): Quick heads-up  Milestone 15 is trending late because infra found a persistent KV hotkey pattern and sales surfaced two deals needing tenant isolation. My suggestion: enforce a hard carve for MVP-lite: ship SSO, billing telemetry, and a single-tenant promptstore admin w/ export. Push multi-tenant routing, tenant QoS, and analytics to v1. This reduces infra churn and gives Sales a shipable GA promise. Thoughts?

rebecca (Eng): +1 on the carve. We should call it "MVP-lite" in docs to avoid confusion. Quick tech Q: will API keys be per-customer or per-tenant? If per-customer we can keep auth simple.

kai (PM): Per-customer API keys for MVP-lite. Per-tenant keying is a v1 item.

omar (Infra): Multi-tenant routing touches our KV sharding assumptions. Est: 3-5 days infra + 2 days e2e. Risk to 99.9th latency is non-trivial. Recommend adding a conservative global limiter for GA. Example limiter we can ship now:
```json
{"global_rps": 700, "per_key_rps": 300, "burst_ms": 1000, "fallback_model": "rw-small"}
```
That keeps noisy workloads from impacting the cluster.

ivy (Design): For the console, we can add a temporary "tenant toggle" under Admin to let customers pick a dataset to operate on. Wireframes are low-effort; I can push them today. UX note: label it clearly "Single-tenant mode (GA)" so users aren't surprised.

nina (Sales): Two enterprise leads will accept GA if we commit to a firm v1 window and include it in a customer note. We need the note to mention: GA = single-tenant promptstore + SSO; v1 = multi-tenant + QoS + analytics, target date or sprint. Also ask Legal to review the language.

legal-bot: legal-queue: please attach PRD link and proposed customer language for review. Estimated turnaround: 48 business hours.

rebecca (Eng): Billing telemetry must be stable. We need an event envelope spec before freeze. Also want to temporarily disable webhooks (v1) to reduce surface area.

kai (PM): Agreed. Acceptance criteria for MVP-lite (proposed):
- SSO (Okta/Google) enabled for admin and API key exchange
- Billing telemetry emitted per request (stable envelope v1.0)
- Single-tenant promptstore admin: CRUD + CSV import/export only
- Global conservative rate limiter active by default
- Canary rollout + health probes for GA
If infra/eng/law have blockers, flag them now.

omar (Infra): We can deliver limiter + canary hooks within 48h if we reprioritize two infra cycles. It

 will also add a runtime flag for a "trial-tenant" that Sales can flip for beta customers.

rebecca (Eng): If infra provides limiter + telemetry spec by EOD Tue, Eng will scope down the API surface and freeze code by end of sprint. Otherwise we keep the original scope and push GA.

kai (PM): Plan: if no blockers by EOD Tue, update roadmap, publish customer note, and send the "MVP-lite" doc to Sales + Legal. Will also add a short FAQ for Support about rate limits.

deploy-bot: CI: Canary pipeline queued: milestone-15/mvp-lite (ci#9271) :rocket:

nina (Sales): Thanks  
 I
ll prep customer talking points once Legal signs off.

kai (PM): Great. I
ll post the updated roadmap entry and ping leads.
